# SelfHostAI

> A curated directory of open-source AI tools you can self-host (LLM runtimes, chat UIs, agent builders, RAG, vector databases, speech and image generation), with licence, category, GitHub repository and alternatives for each tool, plus comparison guides.

Last updated 2026-10-15. Every page has a Markdown twin at the same URL plus `.md`. Information only, not financial or tax advice.

## Guides

- [Best self-hosted ChatGPT alternatives (2026)](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/best-self-hosted-chatgpt-alternatives.html.md): Open-source, self-hostable ChatGPT alternatives: Open WebUI, LibreChat, AnythingLLM, Jan and the runtimes behind them.
- [Ollama vs llama.cpp vs vLLM: which local LLM runtime?](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/ollama-vs-llama-cpp-vs-vllm.html.md): Compare Ollama, llama.cpp and vLLM for running LLMs locally or on a server.
- [Open WebUI vs LibreChat vs AnythingLLM (self-hosted chat UIs)](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/open-webui-vs-librechat-vs-anythingllm.html.md): Compare three popular self-hosted AI chat interfaces by use case and licence.

## Pages

- [Advertise](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/advertise.html.md): Sponsor

## Data

- [api/tools.json](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/api/tools.json): All listed self-hostable AI tools with category, licence, GitHub repo and page URL
- [openapi.json](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the static JSON file
- [llms-full.txt](https://andreiturcea-creator.github.io/selfhost-ai-dir/llms-full.txt): full plain-text content of every page
